title.en: Move the people using it to GDPR Chat

detail.en: Same experience your staff already know, hosted in the EU, with a processing agreement and no training on your content.

alternativeNote.en: No free fix exists for this one. Three European alternatives, if you would rather not use ours.

verification.statement: The people named have stopped using the previous assistant for anything involving a customer.

label.en: Send this to the people using it

subject.en: Switching the assistant we use for customer replies

body.en:
Hi,

We've found that customer details — names, addresses, order information — are going into an assistant hosted outside the EU that we don't have an agreement covering. We need to stop that continuing.

From Monday, please use the EU-hosted one for anything involving a customer. It works the same way, so there's nothing to learn.

Nothing you've done is a problem and nobody is in trouble. We just found it and we're fixing it.

Ask me if anything is unclear.
